name: sniff-mcp
description: Agent-callable canine genomics: an open MCP server and REST API over the Sniff Atlas, breed-stratified allele frequencies for 9.67M variants genome-wide across 188 dog breeds, with SnpEff annotation, Pangolin splice values, phyloP conservation and a variant, gene, breed and disease knowledge graph. Assigns no pathogenicity to any variant.
author: Matt Gehring <matt@sniff.world>
